title: Browser-local PDF form builder, filler, signer and page editor
user: Individuals and small-office staff who need to fill, sign, prepare, or rearrange PDFs without uploading confidential documents.
smallest_useful_product: Open a PDF locally; fill existing AcroForm fields; add text, checkbox, date, and signature fields; draw or type a signature; reorder, delete, and rotate pages; export editable or flattened.
constraints: No OCR or editing existing PDF text
No upload endpoint or cloud storage
Browser memory limits very large scanned PDFs
Signatures are marks, not qualified e-signatures
